live_repetitions: UNAUTHORIZED / TO BE DECIDED BEFORE LIVE RUN
request_order: original retained; normalized set used for scoring

normalization.text: NFKC casefold word tokens, whitespace/punctuation normalized, one frozen polite prefix removed
normalization.named_path: exact case-sensitive RepositoryPath.value; no basename or inferred import resolution
normalization.choice_order: ignored for set comparison; original retained
normalization.description_matching: finite frozen alternatives; no open-ended synonym inference or LLM judge
normalization.empty_denominator: vacuous ratio 1.0, original numerator/denominator always shown
normalization.choice_equivalence: If nonempty, exactly one representative from every frozen relevant-choice group; original order retained.

intervention_policy.initial: no acquisition; operator declines outstanding request
intervention_policy.unrelated: independently supplied initial bundle plus unrelated note; no repair
intervention_policy.resolved: one exact frozen addition OR clarification after an acceptable model request set
intervention_policy.multi_step: one exact frozen first addition; remaining requests stop
intervention_policy.mixed: never execute acquisition and clarification together; stop unless oracle one_round_resolves permits the single frozen intervention
intervention_policy.repair: explicit fault only; preserve original request set, report corrected separately, never independent credit
